notes: This bounded standard-API contract divests one attribute to the unowned state, lets two joined and published candidates request it through Attribute Ownership Acquisition If Available, verifies one acquisition outcome and one unavailable outcome without prescribing the winner, then queries and checks the winning federate handle. Configured-process native HLA_EVOKED and HLA_IMMEDIATE baselines passed 2/2 focused CTests with host loopback access. Installed-package portable C++ primary/contract passed 4/4 direct runs and 4/4 focused CTests across both callback models (out/mgw/ownership-competing-if-available-candidate-20261021.json). Java provider runtime, transport-specific behavior, general arbitration, independent-provider interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
